fato_historico: 2003: Iraq War: In Nasiriyah, Iraq, at least 23 people, among them the first Italian casualties of the 2003 invasion of Iraq, are killed in a suicide bomb attack on an Italian police base.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace resilience today. Just as history shows that even in moments of profound stillness after turbulence, the human spirit seeks healing, your heart may find power in gentle reflection. It is a good time to release past heavy burdens and consider how your inner warmth can light the path forward for yourself and those you love.
frase_do_dia: True strength rises from the ashes of yesterday into the light of tomorrow.
significado_numero: A number symbolizing the transformative power of collective human experience.
conselho: Focus on nurturing your peace and offering kindness to your own soul today.
